entries.fact: DIFF = Previous - Current. VAR = DIFF / Previous. When Previous is zero, VAR is unavailable. Grand-total VAR uses grand-total DIFF divided by grand-total Previous.
The uploaded example reports are layout references, not current sales data. New uploaded sales reports determine quantities and net sales.
MAX uses Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct with Transformers.js and q4 weights. Browser model downloads/cache and available device memory affect startup; this is local inference, not model retraining.
entries.source: Qwen ONNX model card and Transformers.js v3

entries.fact: A browser may expose WebGPU but return no GPU adapter. MAX checks the adapter and falls back to WASM on the CPU if GPU setup fails. CPU inference may be slower.
entries.source: MDN WebGPU and Transformers.js WebGPU guide; MAX runtime implementation

entries.fact: Browser speech recognition has limited support and may send audio to the browser provider's service. Local MAX text inference does not make microphone transcription offline. Typing remains available.
MAX tests a key by requesting the provider's model list. A saved connection is not proof that a paid generation will succeed; the requested model's permissions and API quota still apply.
entries.source: OpenAI model-list reference; MAX connection implementation

entries.fact: MAX's default cloud image model is gpt-image-2.5-sunburst through the Images API; it returns PNG image data. This is separate from the on-device text model and requires API access.
entries.source: OpenAI image-generation guide; MAX creation implementation

entries.fact: SpreadsheetML uses oddHeader/oddFooter on all pages when differentOddEven is false. MAX keeps a repeating grayscale report footer with MG/date and page numbers; its report paper options remain Letter, Legal and Ledger in either orientation.
entries.source: Microsoft Open XML HeaderFooter reference; owner print requirements
